origin: ICAR | Cattle Milk Recording and Data Exchange guidelines
deliverables: data-exchange specification between recording devices and databases
approval and checking procedures for milk-recording devices (98% ID read rate)
note: Snippet-only. Linking cow, weight and sample at the milking is a keyed join with mandatory referents (C02); the 98% read-rate device gate is an accuracy-gated measured envelope (P268) under provider qualification (R28); vendor-format-or-ADE exchange is a declared adapter choice at the boundary.

stress.condition: three AMS brands, one reader degrades to 94%
stress.note: a per-device measured envelope and a partial certification state; the source's pass/fail gate cannot express it, the catalogue's state set can

origin: AgStack (Linux Foundation) | Asset Registry GeoID
deliverables: API registering a geospatial asset and returning a deterministic 16-character GeoID
note: The open feasibility question, deterministic identity under geometric noise, is the catalogue's bifurcation between canonical bytes (P52) and probabilistic linkage with reviewed candidates (P201); returning only the identifier is a nonleaking join key under F06.

stress.condition: two co-ops register overlapping polygons after a boundary dispute
stress.note: two identities with a recorded overlap and retained alternatives; downstream consumers are forbidden a silent pick

origin: Global Mining Guidelines Group | Open Mining Format
deliverables: open file format for 3D mining data incl. block models, with open-source reference implementation
no_anchor: volumetric block-model grid semantics have no anchoring record (carried from iteration 1)
note: Third appearance of this origin across three iterations. Round trip through two independent implementations to stated precision is the independent-oracle rule with a declared tolerance (P347 shape). Whether estimation-run provenance travels is an unresolved input.

stress.condition: a block model exceeds container limits and must ship in parts
stress.note: a part manifest with a completeness assertion is byte-range reconciliation; the single-file assumption becomes a declared profile

origin: EITI | 2023 Standard Requirement 2.5 beneficial ownership
deliverables: public disclosure of beneficial ownership of extractive companies incl. PEPs, thresholds and control mechanisms
note: Look-through ownership graphs (P202), exact path accounting of interests (P253), nominee and trust structures with typed unknowns (P254) and cyclic interests (P291) anchor this case unusually well; MSG designation of high-risk companies is local authority over scope (F10).

stress.condition: a named beneficial owner faces credible threats after publication
stress.note: a pre-publication safety gate with a declared redaction notice; whether the Standard permits redaction stays an unresolved input, retained

origin: Open Source Ecology | Global Village Construction Set
deliverables: fabrication-ready plans for 50 modular machines documented for several audiences
8x cost target
no_anchor: mechanical module interface compatibility (power couplings, hydraulics) has no anchoring record beyond P320 geometry
note: A module library with shared interfaces is a feature model with requires and excludes (P260); the cost ratio is a quantitative constraint on every module (P170 break-even shape); multi-audience documentation from one source is X11. Interface standard not located stays an unresolved input.

stress.condition: a module redesigned for a regional hydraulic standard
stress.note: a regional variant with versioned interface compatibility; cost claims become profile-scoped

origin: lowRISC | OpenTitan silicon root of trust
deliverables: open silicon root of trust with a security model covering attestation, provisioning, secure boot, lifecycle, firmware update, identity and ownership transfer
trademark gated on conformance
no_anchor: silicon lifecycle fusing as an irreversible physical state transition has no anchoring record; P216 covers the guarded lifecycle model
note: Thin on the hardware side, as with iteration 1's RISC-V cases. Ownership transfer is authority handover as a lifecycle transition (P216, P256) with chip identity preserved across it (P284); the trademark gate is conformance as a naming licence (F31 plus F08).

stress.condition: the owning company dissolves with ownership never transferred
stress.note: a device with no counterparty for the transfer is a terminal lifecycle state the catalogue records; conformance says nothing about end-of-life custody, which the catalogue separates as F32

origin: Green Button Alliance | ESPI (NAESB REQ.21) reference stack
deliverables: machine-to-machine interface for a data custodian to share usage data with regulator-qualified third parties under customer consent
OAuth2 reference modules
note: Customer consent and regulator qualification as two conjunctive gates is separate gate decisions (P199) on the authority field; revocation within one refresh cycle is the freshness fence (P244).

stress.condition: regulator withdraws a third party's qualification while grants are active
stress.note: authority has a dependency closure; a withdrawn upstream qualification invalidates dependent grants, so the authorisation server must be a subscriber, which the catalogue makes explicit

origin: EVRoaming Foundation | OCPI 2.3.0
deliverables: core specification with separately released optional modules for roaming
note: Same organisation as iteration 1's D-01 (2.2.1), one version later. Optional modules versioned separately make capability discovery a feature-model question (P260, P343); the CDR recomputing from the tariff at session start is bitemporal selection (P211) with settlement reconciliation (P154).

stress.condition: a tariff changes mid-session
stress.note: the same stress as iteration 1; tariff version pinned at session start, scheme rules supply the pin

origin: Basel Convention Secretariat | e-waste technical guidelines (waste versus non-waste)
deliverables: guidelines distinguishing waste from non-waste for used EEE in transboundary movement
PIC procedure for e-waste
note: Non-binding guidance with binding consequences is the modality gradient from the break watch: the classification rule is MAY in authority and MUST in effect, which the meaning field carries as declared modality plus an A11 acceptance by the applying state. Two officers reaching the same class is reliability measurement (P288).

stress.condition: a consignment is 60% functional and 40% untested
stress.note: a totality check finds the mixed-lot gap; the catalogue splits the population before classifying, which the guidelines' silence leaves to the officer

origin: WHO | Sanitation Safety Planning, 2nd edition
deliverables: sanitation safety plan across containment, conveyance, treatment and end use
monitoring plan with corrective actions before hazard breakthrough
no_anchor: hazard-to-exposure-group control mapping in a service chain has no anchoring record beyond P199 and P218
note: HACCP-shaped control with operational limits and corrective actions is guarded monitoring (P218, P237) feeding a corrective workflow; monitoring latency bounded by breakthrough time is the resources and time field on the monitor. Informal actors outside managerial authority are a missing-authority edge.

stress.condition: informal emptiers outside the utility's authority dominate conveyance
stress.note: the acceptance criterion for that step is recorded as unachievable under current authority; protection by other means is a separate construction, not a silent substitute

origin: Brick Consortium | Brick schema
deliverables: uniform building metadata schema: RDF class hierarchy, minimal relationship set, encapsulation
points as data producers and consumers
no_anchor: minimality of a relationship set as a guarded design constraint (carried from iteration 2)
note: Rediscovered document from iteration 2 (N-01). An unmodified application running against two independently authored models is portability as refinement checking (P286); the point-to-BMS-address mapping is the identity field on the live binding.

stress.condition: an application needs a point type Brick does not define
stress.note: a declared local extension keeps the model portable-with-exceptions; an undeclared one validates and silently is not, which the catalogue forbids

origin: US OSHA | 29 CFR 1926 Subpart M fall protection
deliverables: compliant fall protection system per activity and surface, with training
surface strength determination gating access
note: The 6-foot trigger is a unit-bearing threshold rule (P282, P192); the strength determination gating access is a readiness barrier (P257); per-worker training records resolving for every worker-hour is training-record checking (P183) joined to qualified assignment (P223).

stress.condition: three employers' crews on one surface at once
stress.note: one physical determination, three legal duties: an inherited-obligation conflict strategy over a shared resource, which the catalogue requires to be named before work

origin: European Union | Regulation 2018/858 Art. 61 and Annex X repair and maintenance information
deliverables: standardised website access to OBD and repair information for independent operators
approval and employee authorisation route for security features
note: Accreditation to operator approval to employee authorisation is a chain of delegated authority with a dependency closure (P196); revoking one employee without disturbing the operator is scoped authority withdrawal (P256) with a freshness fence at next use (P244).

stress.condition: an accredited entity's accreditation lapses
stress.note: the closure of authority names every dependent authorisation; a cascade rule is required and the catalogue keeps non-security access alive as a separate scoped grant

origin: OpenPEPPOL | Peppol BIS Billing 3.0
deliverables: Core Invoice Usage Specification of EN 16931 with Schematron artefacts
mandatory endpoint identifier and buyer reference
note: A CIUS that restricts but never contradicts the base is a refinement of consumer assumptions over producer guarantees (P302); two rule sets whose failure messages cite rule identifiers is the explained-verdict obligation. The endpoint identifier being both business data and routing address is one identity in two roles.

stress.condition: buyer's electronic address changes mid-dispute; historical invoices reference a dead endpoint
stress.note: versioned address mapping with the buyer reference as the stable correlation key; credit notes carry both, which the catalogue derives from identity history

origin: MobilityData | GBFS v3.1-RC3
deliverables: JSON feed files with required and conditionally required status, HTTPS, UTF-8, no 404, 5-minute freshness, ttl on every response
note: A hard 5-minute staleness ceiling with ttl as the polling contract is the boundary time field with freshness and poll interval (P244, P218); IDs resolving between information and status feeds is referential shape validation (P194).

stress.condition: telemetry backend down while the web server serves stale files
stress.note: no-404 satisfied and freshness violated is exactly the stale state the fence detects; ttl is the only signal because it is the only time field the feed carries

origin: MobilityData / GTFS community | GTFS Schedule Reference (2026-04-27)
deliverables: dataset of defined files with per-field presence conditions incl. demand-responsive zones
note: Rediscovered document from iteration 1 (H-01). The new element is demand-responsive zones as an alternative to stops, a conditional requirement over spatial objects (P326, P192).

stress.condition: fixed routes and demand-responsive zones in one feed
stress.note: the condition is evaluated per partition of trips; the catalogue's totality check restates the rule so zones never license omitting fixed-route stops

origin: Codex Alimentarius | CXC 1-1969 General Principles of Food Hygiene with HACCP annex
deliverables: HACCP-based food safety plan on prerequisite good hygiene practices, applying all seven principles
note: A principle-based text that must be made specific per kitchen is F01 formalisation retaining typed gaps, then a configurator deriving a plan (F37, P303): the catalogue blocks the executable rule until the local acceptance supplies the limit, which is the scale-proportionality the source demands. CCP limits with monitoring frequency and corrective actions are guarded temporal monitors (P218).

stress.condition: kitchen switches to cook-chill mid-year; the analysed flow is now wrong
stress.note: a changed process invalidates the hazard analysis before the change is admitted; re-derivation is ordered, not implied

origin: Open Food Facts | data and write API
deliverables: API to add or edit products by barcode; derived Nutri-Score, NOVA, allergens, Green-Score as a function of contributed fields and photos
note: Derived scores as a function of contribution completeness is a declared partial population feeding rule-based derivation (P4) and learned photo extraction (P335, P336); allergen absent versus allergen data absent is the four-state evidence axis, which the catalogue forbids collapsing.

stress.condition: manufacturer reformulates without changing the barcode
stress.note: barcode identity is time-scoped; a third state, data may predate reformulation, is a known-at qualifier the catalogue already carries

origin: OpenAPI Initiative | OpenAPI Specification 3.1.1
deliverables: OpenAPI document and description conforming to 3.1.1: openapi field, paths/components/webhooks, path template parameters, JSON Schema 2020-12 types
note: Same organisation and document family as iteration 1's J-04 (3.2.0). Path template expressions matching declared parameters is referential shape validation (P194); one artefact serving readers, generators and testers is X11 with three consumers.

stress.condition: a referenced document declares a different openapi version
stress.note: version homogeneity across an OAD is a join constraint the catalogue asserts explicitly; per-document validity does not imply it

origin: W3C/WAI | WCAG 2.2
deliverables: guidelines, success criteria, Understanding pages and techniques by technology; conformance claims
note: Normative criteria versus non-normative techniques is F01's document authority and scope; a conformance claim naming version, level, scope and date is a scoped claim ledger (P250); version supersetting is a declared dialect relation.

stress.condition: a conforming technique unsupported by a widely used assistive technology
stress.note: the assistive technology is the actual consumer; conformance against the specification alone is exactly what HG04 refuses to accept

origin: Mojaloop | FSPIOP, Settlement and Third-party APIs
deliverables: interoperability APIs between FSPs with JWS/JWE protection, scheme-rule parameters, irrevocable agreed transactions, unmodified payloads through intermediaries
note: Irrevocability after mutual agreement with compensating rather than corrective error handling is the saga with declared compensation (C10, P243) over canonical signed bytes (P262, P247); transaction identity end to end is the boundary identity field. First F13 primary case with strong anchors.

stress.condition: payee account closed between quote and transfer; abort must differ from timeout
stress.note: pre-agreement failure is a clean abort state distinct from timeout; the catalogue's state set already separates them

origin: FIX Trading Community | FIXP 1.1 session layer
deliverables: lightweight session layer with negotiable, possibly asymmetric delivery guarantees per direction over stream, datagram or message transports
note: Per-direction negotiated guarantees are two boundary contracts on one session; recovery after transport loss without duplication on idempotent or recoverable flows is checkpoint recovery with late correction (P328) and duplicate reconciliation (P242). Unread flow definitions stay an unresolved input.

stress.condition: the recoverable direction fails during recovery of the idempotent direction
stress.note: per-direction recovery state with an explicit interference contract; a shared re-establishment procedure is the resequencing hazard the catalogue names under C03
